name: LF Closed Change
notes: Forward on the left foot, side on the right, close the left to the right: a reverse-to-natural link. Standard name (International Style waltz); the owner's class doesn't name it. Owner's description (2026-11-16): one of a mirrored pair with RF Closed Change, each tracing a corner of a square; no turn, the lead progressing forward and the follow backward; both halves go forward for the lead. Sizes as the box turn, agreed by the owner: 0.5 forward, then the side step lands level with the forward foot and 0.4 to its side; no rise. Standard technique has the side step slightly forward; the owner dances it level. In the frame the step starts from, the side step travels 0.5 forward and 0.2 across, because the moving foot starts beside the other foot's heel.
